v4/outputs/lead_prelim_rank.csv, v4/data/d4_live_snapshot.parquet, v4/data/d3_xbrl_facts.parquet, v4/data/d4_validation_sec.csv, v4/data/d4_corporate_events.csv (internal program data, as of 2026-09-25 close)
finance-skills:stock-analysis skill scripts/ratios.py and scripts/valuation.py output (run 2026-09-26)

caveats: FMP MCP connector (statements/earningsTranscript/insiderTrades/secFilings) was rate-limited for the entire session (shared API plan under concurrent load from the overnight multi-agent run) -- all figures were sourced instead from SEC EDGAR direct fetches, local cached XBRL (d3_xbrl_facts.parquet), and WebSearch/WebFetch against primary and reputable secondary sources. No FMP data is used in the dossiers.

The Agent tool's concurrent-subagent limit was reached when this agent (f6) attempted to delegate one sub-diligence-agent per ticker; per instructions the delegation was not retried, and all three dossiers were produced directly by this agent instead.

Some granular items (exact debt maturity schedules, precise SBC%, a full insider Form 4 pattern, and a full re-read of each FY2025 10-K's legal-proceedings/risk-factor sections) were not completed to the same depth as the core financial and guidance analysis, and are flagged as specific follow-up items within each dossier rather than silently omitted.

Several ratios.py/valuation.py inputs (D&A, interest expense, tax for periods not directly available in the cached XBRL slice pulled) are reasonable estimates rather than exact filed figures -- each dossier discloses this inline where it applies.
